Librarius.name: Psionic Scourge
Librarius.effect: Roll 1D6 and add the caster's Ld score. The target suffers one automatic wound for each point of difference to its own Ld value with Strength: 4 AP: 0 Damage: 1; Seeking.

Librarius.name: Fury of the Ancients
Librarius.effect: The target suffers five hits with Strength: 6 AP: -2 D: 1; Seeking.

Librarius.name: Power of Heroes
Librarius.effect: The target gains +2 Strength and +2 Attacks.

Librarius.name: Null Zone
Librarius.effect: All enemy units in range lose their ward saving throw. Psychic test results from enemy units are halved.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Void Darts
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The target suffers D6 automatic hits with S: 5 AP: -2 D: 1; Shred.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Seal the Veil
Esoterist (Anathemata).target: Enemy unit that has declared a charge against the caster's unit
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: Can only be cast as part of a Defensive Fire reaction. If the target has the "Daemon" or "Greater Daemon" ability, its charge move is reduced to 3" and it cannot set up within 1" of the caster's unit.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Warp Ward
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The target gains a 5+ ward save against wounds caused by models with the "Daemon" or "Greater Daemon" ability.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Banish
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: Both the Psyker and the target roll a D6 and add their respective Leadership values. If the Psyker's total is greater than or equal to the target's, the target suffers D3 Mortal Wounds if it has the "Daemon" or "Greater Daemon" ability, otherwise one Mortal Wound.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Rend the Veil
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The target suffers a -1 penalty to manifest and deny psychic powers.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Sanctic Focus
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The Void Darts of the caster gain +1 Damage.

Stormcalling (White Scars).name: Unseen Bolt
Stormcalling (White Scars).effect: The target suffers one hit with Strength: 4 AP: -2 D: 1; Blast(5), Suppression(2).

Stormcalling (White Scars).name: Call of the Wind
Stormcalling (White Scars).effect: The target gains +1" Movement for each point of the Initiative characteristic of its models when it makes a Move order, but cannot make an Advance move.
Stormcalling (White Scars).duration: Until the end of the activation

Stormcalling (White Scars).name: Hurricane
Stormcalling (White Scars).effect: The enemy unit must make a Dangerous Terrain test the next time it activates, and its movement is hindered accordingly. Also affects units that normally ignore terrain or remain stationary.

Stormcalling (White Scars).name: Thunderblast
Stormcalling (White Scars).effect: All models of the target suffer an automatic wound with Strength: 4 AP: 0 D: 1; Seeking. Additionally, the target gains one Battleshock token.

Stormcalling (White Scars).name: Stormcaller
Stormcalling (White Scars).effect: The target gains the benefit of light cover.

Stormcalling (White Scars).name: Spirits of Chogoris
Stormcalling (White Scars).effect: The target receives a -1 penalty to their Leadership and to all hit rolls.

Runecasting (Space Wolves).name: Wrath of the Death Wolf
Runecasting (Space Wolves).effect: The target suffers D6 automatic hits with Strength: 6 AP: 0 D: 1; Suppression(2).

Runecasting (Space Wolves).name: Stormwrought
Runecasting (Space Wolves).effect: Can only be cast when the target is the target of a ranged attack. Hit rolls of that attack suffer a -1 penalty (cumulative with cover).
Runecasting (Space Wolves).duration: Until the end of the attack

Runecasting (Space Wolves).name: Awoken Instincts
Runecasting (Space Wolves).effect: The target gains the "Favoured enemy", "Furious charge" and "Move through cover" abilities.

Runecasting (Space Wolves).name: Blasting Gale
Runecasting (Space Wolves).effect: The target's Movement is halved, rounding up.

Runecasting (Space Wolves).name: Maw of the World Wolf
Runecasting (Space Wolves).effect: Draw a straight 1" wide line from the caster in any direction. All creatures touched by the line must pass an initiative test or suffer one Mortal Wound. Vehicles suffer an automatic Hull point loss with no save allowed.

Runecasting (Space Wolves).name: Eye of the Storm
Runecasting (Space Wolves).effect: Roll 1D6 for each enemy unit in range, adding +1 if the unit has the "Anti-Grav" ability or is a Flyer or Jump Pack unit. On a 3+, the unit suffers one Mortal Wound.

Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).name: Drake's Breath
Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).effect: The target suffers four automatic hits with Strength: 5 AP: -2 D: 1; Seeking.

Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).name: Forgefire Blade
Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).effect: The target gains +1 Strength and -1 AP for one melee weapon.

Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).name: Scales of the Drake
Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).effect: All attacks reduce their Strength and AP by 1 against the target.

Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).name: Molten Lance
Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).effect: The target suffers one hit with Strength: 8 AP: -5 D: 2; AT(4), Melta, Seeking.

Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).name: Burning Ground
Fury of the Salamander (Salamanders).effect: The target must make a dangerous terrain test. If it was standing inside or on a terrain piece, the terrain becomes dangerous terrain until the end of the game.
